solves.reason: (A) describes - 소설이 섬을 묘사함. (B) popular - very popular. (C) correct - misguided belief를 바로잡다. ③이 정답.
(A) believed - It is believed. (B) exploring - were exploring. (C) established - well established. ④이 정답.
(A) appeared - appeared in print. (B) mistook - mistook...for. (C) misguided - misguided belief. ④이 정답.
② unpopular는 원문 popular의 반의어. 소설이 very popular했으므로 unpopular가 부적절.
④ maintain은 원문 correct의 반의어. It took years to correct인데 maintain은 유지하다로 반대.
③ identified는 원문 mistook의 반의어. 착각한 게 아니라 알아보았다면 문맥과 반대.
island paradise. 빈칸에 paradise가 들어가야 섬 낙원이 됨.
the fictional island. 소설 속 가상의 섬이므로 fictional.
the legend of California was widely known. 전설이므로 legend.
describes = depicts. 둘 다 묘사하다.
mistook = confused. 둘 다 혼동/착각하다.
established = recognized. 둘 다 확립/인정된.
fictional(가상의) ↔ authentic(실제의). imaginary는 동의어.
widely(널리) ↔ narrowly(좁게). broadly/extensively/commonly 모두 동의어.
(A) in print = 인쇄물. (B) print on window = 자국. ① 인쇄물-자국.
물로 거의 둘러싸인 좁은 땅 = peninsula(반도).
the _____ (legendary) of California. the+of = 명사 필요. legendary→legend.
the _____ (misguide) belief. belief 수식 형용사 필요. misguide→misguided.
the first place the word California appeared in print. ② appeared in print.
had already been well established as the name. ③ well established as the name.
